newsitem.title: CANADA: N Prairie grainbelt faces high risk of frost Tues.
newsitem.headline: N Prairie grainbelt faces high risk of frost Tues.

text.p: Canada's northern Prairie grainbelt was forecast to see a high risk of frost Tuesday morning, Environment Canada said.
A moderate risk of frost was also likely in south Alberta and a slight risk in south Saskatchewan and south Manitoba, Environment Canada said in its 10-day frost outlook.

A high risk of frost was forecast for the entire Prairie grainbelt Wednesday morning and the entire region Thursday morning except in south Alberta and southwest Saskatchewan where a moderate risk was expected.
A slight risk was seen on the south grainbelt Oct 4 and 5.
A moderate risk of frost was forecast for the northern grainbelt Oct 4 and 5.
A high risk of frost was expected for the entire region Oct 6 to Oct 9.
Alberta's harvest was 50 percent complete by Sept 23, Saskatchewan's harvest was 52 percent done on that date while Manitoba's harvest was about 75 percent done.
Harvest delays on the west Prairie were due to rain and snow.
